title: CdpClient InputGuard: _transparentHwnd mismatch fixed -- ExitTransparency uses saved hwnd not current
desc: EnterTransparency saved WS_EX_TRANSPARENT on hwnd A but ExitTransparency used current ChromeWindowHandle (potentially hwnd B after Chrome restart), leaving hwnd A permanently transparent. Fixed by saving _transparentHwnd at Enter and restoring it at Exit.
steps: BUG: EnterTransparency sets WS_EX_TRANSPARENT on hwnd at Enter time. ExitTransparency reads ChromeWindowHandle at Exit time -- if Chrome restarted between calls, this is a DIFFERENT hwnd. Old hwnd keeps WS_EX_TRANSPARENT forever (click-through, interferes with nearby windows).

FIX: Added _transparentHwnd field. EnterTransparency saves hwnd on 0->1 edge. ExitTransparency uses _transparentHwnd (saved hwnd) not ChromeWindowHandle. finally block resets _transparentHwnd=Zero and _savedExStyle=0 after restore.
COMMIT: 04c410483 fix(cdp): InputGuard save _transparentHwnd at Enter.
SECONDARY BUG (also fixed): _savedExStyle was never reset after restore -- stale value on next cycle if GetWindowLong failed.
